name: Light Tracing with Per-Vertex Sensor Connections
definition:
A rendering method where paths start from emitters and propagate into the scene. At every scattering vertex $x_i$ ($i 
eq 1$), the renderer tests for unoccluded connections to the sensor. If connected and the surface is non-specular, the path contributes flux to a pixel. This creates a 'one-path-many-pixels' structure, contrasting with viewpoint path tracing's 'one-path-one-pixel' property.
